findings.title: Validate ChoiceFormat branch text instead of discarding it
findings.body: For link-expiration units and error-invalid-multivalued-size, normalization removes the entire choice expression, including its display text, before anchor validation or HTML sanitization. A valid quoted branch such as `1#'minute'` therefore passes verification because only `...` is checked. The original resource is still shipped, and MessageFormat expands that HTML at runtime. This bypasses the restriction on new links and forbidden HTML. Validate the branch outputs rather than excluding the whole expression.

findings.title: Retain i18next interpolation in the React console bundles
findings.body: This React console resource replaces i18next placeholders (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}`) with Java MessageFormat syntax. i18next does not interpolate single-braced arguments or evaluate Java choice expressions, so multivalued-attribute validation errors display literal placeholders and the choice expression instead of the attribute name and bounds. The admin-ui English bundle contains the same regression. Keep the Java syntax in server-side bundles and use i18next-compatible interpolation and pluralization in both React bundles.

findings.title: Prevent the diagnostic prefix and suffix from overlapping
findings.body:
The common-suffix loop can consume characters already counted by the common-prefix loop. For example, an English entry `key=

` is sanitized to `

`, producing start=3 and end=2. The subsequent call to value.substring(3, 1) throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of returning an Illegal HTML finding. Thus malformed resources can crash verification and suppress the remaining diagnostics. Limit suffix matching to the portions left after removing the prefix.

findings.title: Restrict the anchor exception to the actual a element
findings.body: The anchor pattern also matches every tag whose name starts with `a`, including article, audio, and applet. English bundles are compared with themselves, so an entry such as `<article onclick="alert(1)">Click</article>` has both tags removed as supposedly trusted anchors and passes verification without its event handler reaching OWASP. Translations copying those tags pass too, despite them being outside the allowed policy. Require a tag-name boundary after `a` so non-anchor elements are validated normally.

findings.title: Replace the Italian instruction with Lithuanian text
findings.body: The replacement loginTotpStep1 text, `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, is Italian rather than Lithuanian. The same replacement appears in the Lithuanian account bundle's totpStep1. Users selecting Lithuanian now receive the authenticator installation instruction in another language. Translate both replacements into Lithuanian.

findings.title: Keep the zh_CN instruction in Simplified Chinese
findings.body: The new totpStep1 uses Traditional Chinese characters and terminology (`手機`, `安裝`, `應用程式`) in the Simplified Chinese zh_CN bundle. This replaces a correctly localized instruction with text for the other Chinese locale. Use a Simplified Chinese replacement consistent with the surrounding messages.
